{{Recipe}}

This recipe was found in Githima, a small town outside the city of Nakuru in Kenya. If you ask for fried eggs in the West of Kenya, you'll probably have the eggs scribbled.

== Ingredients ==

* [[Cookbook:Oil and Fat|Oil]]
* [[Cookbook:Tomato|Tomatoes]] (optional), [[Cookbook:Chopping|chopped]]
* [[Cookbook:Scallion|Scallion]] (optional), [[Cookbook:Slicing|sliced]]
* 2 [[Cookbook:Egg|eggs]]

== Procedure ==

# Heat a small amount of oil in a [[Cookbook:Skillet|skillet]] over medium heat.
# If using tomatoes, add them to the pan. [[Cookbook:Frying|Fry]] for a minute.
# If using scallion, add to tomatoes. Cook for another minute.
# Beat the eggs well, and pour into the pan.
# Start stirring the eggs—Kenyans call this scribbling. Cook like this until the egg is done.
